note: Gate C W2 — C04 (Round Board planning open, unresolved player decision), C05 (planning closed, historical warnings, mixed boundary), C06 (dense allocation, position-precision disclosure). No official Gate C wave-ordering document exists (see SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md) — this wave's scope is self-assigned and provisional, exactly as Gate C W1 disclosed for C01-C03. REMEDIATION PASS (independent review of PR #829, findings P1-01 through P1-07, all fixed — see REVIEW_RECORD.md for the full finding-by-finding disposition): (P1-01) the Resolve control now renders only when a computed `resolvable` flag (derived from the real per-match boundary) is true, not merely when a handler is provided; (P1-02) C05's retained historical warning was corrected from SELECTED_PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE (DRAFT-only in the real engine, impossible on a finalized match) to SQUAD_BELOW_MINIMUM (genuinely producible regardless of boundary); (P1-03) movePlayerToMatch now guards the SOURCE match's boundary as well as the destination's, and proactively offers no destination at all once the selected player's own match is closed; (P1-04) playerId/matchId/idempotencyKey are no longer dropped between the plan-integrity engine and the board; (P1-05) a rejected or errored move now returns a real outcome and shows the real reason, inline or via a shared banner, instead of silently refreshing/closing as if it had succeeded; (P1-06) CoachingIntentSelector's own dynamically-imported server actions are now isolated behind the same command boundary, and Clear/Regenerate are disabled outright in UI Lab rather than faking success; (P1-07) all four routes (including a new denied-assignment sub-route for C06) are registered in the CI capture pipeline and covered by 29 new real-Chromium Playwright tests, run and passing locally in this session. The original two production defects (eligible-coverage data never surfaced; a closed match could accept an assignment from the inspector/sheet) and C06's disclosed BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE_OR_AUTHORITY position-precision gap are unchanged by this pass. See CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md, OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE_SEMANTICS.md, CLOSED_STATE_RULES.md, POSITION_VOCABULARY_AND_PRECISION.md, and REVIEW_RECORD.md for full detail. All three candidates remain CANDIDATE pending owner review.

candidates.baselineAssetRef: PROPOSED_REFINEMENT (implemented) — the eligible-player coverage denominator (RoundPlanIntegrity.coverage) was computed but never surfaced anywhere in production UI prior to this PR; see CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md item 2 and OPPORTUNITY_COVERAGE_SEMANTICS.md. Remediation pass additionally fixed P1-01 (Resolve now gated on a real resolvable flag) and P1-04 (playerId/matchId/idempotencyKey no longer dropped) at the shared production-adapter/page level this candidate also exercises.

PROPOSED_REFINEMENT (implemented) — a real production defect: the suggestion-card assignment path had no isFinalized guard (unlike the allocation matrix's handleMatrixToggle), so a closed match could render as an assignable destination and accept a committed assignment. Fixed and regression-tested; see CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md item 3 and CLOSED_STATE_RULES.md. Remediation pass fixed P1-01 (Resolve gating), P1-02 (the fixture's historical warning corrected to one the real engine can produce), P1-03 (the SOURCE match's boundary is now also guarded, proactively), and P1-05 (truthful rejection feedback) — this candidate exercises all four directly.

BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE_OR_AUTHORITY for the 24-vs-14 position-precision contrast — Round Board's Selection model has no position field at all; the real vocabularies belong to the separate Lineup/Formation editor. Disclosed, not fabricated. A real navigation addition (link to the player's current match's Lineup editor) ships instead. See POSITION_VOCABULARY_AND_PRECISION.md. The dense-matrix and mobile-sheet portions of C06 are fully demonstrated on real production code. Remediation pass added a dedicated, genuinely reachable denied-assignment route (P1-07) and isolated CoachingIntentSelector's own mutation path (P1-06).
knownGaps: Exact 24-code tactical-position precision does not exist inside Round Board's data model — see POSITION_VOCABULARY_AND_PRECISION.md. Not resolvable without a schema/domain change outside this wave's scope.
